procedures.name: Evidence Integrity
procedures.purpose: Establish evidence identity, acquisition scope and available integrity metadata.
steps: Identify each evidence source and acquisition type.
Record source and device identifiers.
Review acquisition metadata and available hashes.
Record timezone and processing scope.
Document verification result and limitations without inventing missing verification data.

procedures.name: Device and System Identification
procedures.purpose: Identify the examined device, operating system and stable identifiers.
steps: Review device information artifacts.
Review operating system and hardware metadata.
Collect hostname, serial, UDID or other stable identifiers where available.
Correlate user accounts and timezone.
Deduplicate repeated representations of the same device.

procedures.name: Files and Documents
procedures.purpose: Identify and validate files, documents and metadata relevant to the report objective.
steps: Select file and document artifact families required by the report.
Collect full path, size, timestamps and hashes where available.
Determine allocation, deletion and recovery state.
Validate significant records against the source file system or source link.
Deduplicate according to file occurrence or content hash as defined by the report.

procedures.name: Application and Execution
procedures.purpose: Separate software presence, installation and execution evidence.
steps: Review installed application evidence.
Review execution-specific artifacts such as Prefetch, UserAssist, BAM/DAM and event logs where applicable.
Review supporting inventory metadata such as Amcache with correct forensic interpretation.
Correlate executable path, user and timestamps.
Do not infer execution from installation or file presence alone.

procedures.name: Browser and Web
procedures.purpose: Identify browser activity while preserving browser/profile/event identity.
steps: Identify browser and profile.
Review history, searches, downloads, bookmarks and other report-relevant browser artifacts.
Normalize URLs and domains.
Correlate files or account data when required.
Prevent Refined Results or parent artifacts from double-counting the same underlying activity.

procedures.name: Communications
procedures.purpose: Identify communications, participants, direction, timestamps and attachments.
steps: Identify communication application and local account.
Recover messages, calls or emails relevant to the report.
Collect participants, direction, timestamp and thread/conversation identifiers.
Associate attachments without counting attachments as messages.
Separate parsed, deleted, carved and partial records.
Count unique communications using native identifiers where available.

procedures.name: Accounts and Authentication
procedures.purpose: Identify accounts and authentication events without conflating account presence with login activity.
steps: Identify system or application accounts.
Review authentication and logon artifacts.
Collect timestamps, source device/IP and result where available.
Distinguish account existence from actual authentication.
Correlate relevant event logs and application records.

procedures.name: Network and External Devices
procedures.purpose: Identify network, remote access and external-device activity.
steps: Review the report-specific network or device artifacts.
Collect stable identifiers such as IP, hostname, SSID, serial number, VID/PID or MAC where available.
Collect user and timestamps where available.
Correlate Registry, event logs, LNK/Jump List or application evidence when relevant.
Count unique devices, sessions or events according to the report definition.

procedures.name: Deletion and Recovery
procedures.purpose: Identify deleted and recovered evidence and clearly state recovery quality.
steps: Review Recycle Bin/Trash, deleted file-system records and carved evidence.
Collect original path, deletion state, timestamps, source offsets and hashes where available.
Separate intact, parsed, carved and partial recovery.
Deduplicate overlapping deleted and carved representations.
Use qualified language for incomplete artifacts.

procedures.name: Persistence and Security
procedures.purpose: Identify persistence, security detections and related configuration.
steps: Review persistence or security artifact families relevant to the report.
Collect configuration source, executable path, user and timestamps.
Correlate execution/log evidence where available.
Distinguish configured persistence from confirmed execution.
Report concrete evidence rather than inferred intent.

procedures.name: Timeline and Location
procedures.purpose: Reconstruct chronology or location while avoiding timestamp-row inflation.
steps: Collect timestamped records relevant to the objective.
Normalize timezone.
Identify the underlying action or event represented by each timestamp.
Collapse duplicate timestamps that describe the same underlying event.
Correlate events across artifact families.
Count normalized events, not raw Timeline rows.

procedures.name: Mobile System and App Activity
procedures.purpose: Analyze mobile device, application and system activity.
steps: Identify device and operating system.
Review report-relevant accounts and applications.
Review system activity sources such as KnowledgeC, Biome, Digital Wellbeing or supported equivalents where applicable.
Correlate application, user, timestamp and device context.
Separate direct activity evidence from contextual application presence.

procedures.name: Cloud Evidence
procedures.purpose: Analyze provider, account, object and cloud activity records.
steps: Identify provider and account.
Identify collection/source type.
Review report-relevant files, messages or events.
Collect actor, action, object and timestamp.
Correlate local and cloud evidence where available.
Treat evidence containers separately from the activity records they contain.

procedures.name: Memory Analysis
procedures.purpose: Analyze volatile evidence while separating memory-only observations from persistent disk evidence.
steps: Validate memory source and analysis profile/plugin.
Review processes, connections, modules or other report-specific artifacts.
Collect PID, process, endpoint and command-line information as applicable.
Correlate volatile evidence with disk artifacts where useful.
Document volatile-source limitations.

procedures.name: Operating System Logs
procedures.purpose: Analyze event and audit logs using unique event identifiers.
steps: Identify log provider, channel or source.
Filter event IDs/categories relevant to the objective.
Collect event timestamp, user, computer, process and result where available.
Normalize duplicate representations.
Count unique log records or normalized events according to the report definition.

procedures.name: Media Analysis
procedures.purpose: Identify media files and metadata with separate occurrence and unique-content counts.
steps: Identify picture, video or audio artifacts.
Collect path, hash and media metadata.
Review EXIF/geolocation where within scope.
Record allocation/deletion state.
Report file occurrences separately from unique content when useful.

procedures.name: Encryption and Credentials
procedures.purpose: Identify protected/encrypted evidence while protecting secrets.
steps: Identify encryption or credential-related artifact families.
Collect source, owner/account and protection mechanism.
Correlate tool/configuration evidence where relevant.
Redact recovered passwords, tokens and secrets from narrative output.
Do not expose credential material unnecessarily.

procedures.name: Search, Hash and IOC
procedures.purpose: Interpret search and indicator matches in context.
steps: Apply defined search, hash or IOC scope.
Identify the underlying source object for each hit.
Deduplicate repeated hits within the same source object.
Validate surrounding context.
Distinguish a keyword occurrence from a meaningful forensic finding.
Correlate with report-relevant artifacts.
